from datetime import datetime, timedelta
import os

ws = wb["Sheet1"]

start = ws["B3"].value
end = ws["F3"].value

# Collect holiday/exclusion dates from column J
holidays = set()
for cell in ws["J"]:
    if isinstance(cell.value, datetime):
        holidays.add(cell.value.date())

# Generate workdays from start through end, excluding weekends and holidays
workdays = []
current = start.date() if isinstance(start, datetime) else start
end_date = end.date() if isinstance(end, datetime) else end

while current <= end_date and len(workdays) < 32:
    if current.weekday() < 5 and current not in holidays:  # Monday-Friday and not excluded
        workdays.append(datetime.combine(current, datetime.min.time()))
    current += timedelta(days=1)

# Fill only H7:H38 with literal date values

    cell = ws[f"H{row}"]
    if idx < len(workdays):
        cell.value = workdays[idx]
        cell.number_format = "m/d/yyyy"
    else:
        cell.value = ""
